scope: Actual SplitEdge commands in owned private Xvfb sessions, using real component mouse picks followed by evaluated source-edge model points. Full geometry, ordered component tables, attributes, selection and Undo/Redo retained.
notes: Only transient source artifact paths were removed from portable requests. Raw result values are unchanged.
Rhino appends split vertices and edges in descending parameter order, independent of point entry order.

Escape after collected points applies the batch. Empty input has no replacement/history. Duplicate interior parameters fail the entire batch. Endpoint-only input has unchanged geometry but a real replacement and Undo/Redo.
The short-feature probes include 1e-12 from an endpoint and 0.0001 between points at document absolute tolerance 0.01. These are retained, not merged under model tolerance.

Construction tolerance is the request/worker tolerance, not Rhino's default document tolerance. No arbitrary-input, screen-picking equivalence, or performance claim follows from these bounded fixtures.
